panels.description: Near GODARAZ, an indistinct customer holds open the Mandarin-labelled manual while another points to an unreadable diagram. The pin-setter clanks in darkness behind them. Keep upper-left clear.
Duda sits on the lane-3 ball return above the crowned lane, framed by the dark machine. Keep the upper third clear.
Guddu holds the manual upside down while Pinty studies it beside him. Keep the space above the manual clear.
The GODARAZ entrance stands bare. Dust has collected in the rectangular footprint where the hand-woven dhurrie lay. Keep the doorway clear.

items.speaker: PINTY
items.text: It is emotionally a wiring diagram.
